messages:
maya (support): FYI customer reported a big p95 spike on the sorting endpoint (/v1/sort) under peak load, causing a bunch of 502/504s. They are on Dedicated, model: llama-3-reorder-v1. Sample request_id: r-0a1b2c3d.

leo (eng-sre): can you paste the customer repro steps + raw gateway logs?

maya (support): customer repro: steady qps ~120 for ~2m, payloads are 6-12 items each. Client does 3 retries with fixed 500ms backoff. Logs: gateway -> "upstream read timeout after 30000ms" for r-0a1b2c3d, backend worker returned 502 for several requests, end-to-end p95 ~2.2s while model runtime p95 ~1.1s.

alex (eng-runtime): interesting — model runtime p95 1.1s but E2E 2.2s suggests queueing/dispatch overhead or retry amplification. What's batching config (max batch, batching latency)?

maya (support): batching target_size=16, batch_latency_ms=30, max_inflight=100 per model, autoscale min_replicas=2 max=8. KV cache hit ~80% according to metrics.

harpreet (prod-reliability): client retries + high concurrency could cause thundering-herd: many small batches + retry storms -> queue growth. Also gateway timeouts indicate requests waiting in proxy longer than model can accept.

leo (eng-sre): any traces with x-request-id or sampling traces? can we see queue_length and inflight counts?

maya (support): uploaded traces and metrics snapshot: queue_length spiked to 420, inflight per-replica peaked at ~48, GPU mem usage ~78%, CPU on cpu-hosts ~92%. Trace link: https://redwood.obs/trace/r-0a1b2c3d (customer allowed access).

sre-bot: INC-1234 created for sorting endpoint p95 spike — paging eng-runtime oncall.

alex (eng-runtime): quick mitigation suggestions: 1) advise customer to remove fixed immediate retries (use exponential backoff + jitter). 2) Add gateway rate-limit (429) and short-circuit for models under queue pressure. 3) Enforce lower max_inflight_per_model (e.g., 32) so backpressure reaches client sooner. 4) Tune batch_latency_ms up slightly to form fuller batches.

maya (support): customer applied workaround: reduced client concurrency by 40% and removed immediate retries -> error rate dropped from ~8% to ~1% within 10m. They're asking for a permanent fix.

leo (eng-sre): we should repro in staging with identical model + quantization + autoscale settings. I'll run a k6 load to replicate their pattern. Repro steps for eng-runtime: run k6 with steady qps 120, payload size distribution 6-12, add client-side 3 retries at 500ms to observe amplification.

alex (eng-runtime): can you paste a small k6 script and a sample curl we can use?

maya (support): here's a simple curl sample for their request body:

```json
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sort \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"context":"search query text","candidates":["A","B","C","D","E","F"]}'
```

and a minimal k6 snippet to mimic their load:

```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export let options = { vus: 200, duration: '3m', rps: 120 };
export default function() {
  let body = JSON.stringify({context: 'q', candidates: new Array(Math.floor(Math.random()*7)+6).fill('item')});
  let res = http.post('https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/sort', body, { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer STAGING_KEY' } });
  if (res.status >= 500) { /* track */ }
  sleep(0.02);
}
```

harpreet (prod-reliability): one more note — look for retry loops between gateway and backend. We saw gateway logs with repeated upstream retries for the same request_id. If gateway is retrying (e.g., 2xx -> upstream retry), that amplifies load too. Confirm gateway retry policy.

leo (eng-sre): checked gateway config: retries enabled with simple backoff, but not enough jitter. I'll patch gateway to add jitter + cap retries to 1 for this model as a short-term measure.

alex (eng-runtime): long-term fixes: adaptive admission control (reject quickly under high queue), smarter batching timeout tuning per traffic distribution, and backpressure signals propagated to clients (429 + Retry-After). Also consider lowering default max_inflight and adding per-tenant concurrency limits.

maya (support): attached customer logs snippet showing the 504 response header and x-request-id:

```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
Date: Mon, 01 Jan 2024 12:34:56 GMT
x-request-id: r-0a1b2c3d
x-upstream-retry: 2
```

leo (eng-sre): next steps: (1) repro in staging (I will run k6), (2) apply gateway retry cap + jitter, (3) propose a short-term config change: max_inflight_per_model=32 for llama-3-reorder-v1 in prod cluster, (4) follow up with customer for permanent capacity/autoscale tuning and client retry guidance.

alex (eng-runtime): assigning to eng-runtime oncall @alex — I'll take a look at traces and batching metrics. Please attach full traces and the exact client SDK version used by customer.

maya (support): added SDK version 2.3.1 in the ticket and shared traces link. Customer is ok with cluster-side mitigations while we do a fuller root-cause.

support-bot: note: thread pinned to channel for visibility.

leo (eng-sre): closing loop — set internal action items and will post a postmortem if we confirm platform-side fixes. For now customer workaround + gateway retry cap reduced incident impact. :white_check_mark:
